newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PCI Leasing 96 net around 255 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: PCI Leasing 96 net around 255 mln pesos.

text.p: PCI Leasing and Finance Inc, which made its debut on the Philippine Stock Exchange on Monday, said it expected its 1996 net income to reach around 255 million pesos from 140 million last year.

"We expect to make around 255 million pesos in net income this year from gross revenues of 1.2 billion pesos," Rene Buenaventura, PCI Leasing's chief operating officer, told Reuters after the firm's IPO was listed.
"Our 1997 forecast is 330 million pesos from gross revenues of between 1.6 to 1.7 million pesos," he said.
PCI Leasing made its debut on the Philippine Stock Exchange on Monday at 7.60 pesos, up from its offering price of 6.95 pesos, brokers said.
The leasing firm, a unit of Philippine Commercial International Bank, had offered 121 million shares.
